source_description: Krypt is a native Android (Kotlin) Zero-Trust offline App Locker. Default-Deny on every installed app: new installs are auto-locked and a Security-Alerts notification is posted naming the package. Locked apps are intercepted by an AccessibilityService + WindowManager overlay before their UI paints. Unlock is a peer-to-peer flow: the Subject device sends an encrypted deep-link (myapp://request?app=...&salt=...&proof=...) via any off-device transport (WhatsApp/SMS/email); the Guardian's own device opens Krypt's Guardian Popup, validates the PIN against the proof using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (>=300k iterations), derives an AES-256 key, and returns an approval deep-link (myapp://approve?data=...). The Subject device decrypts, matches the outstanding request, and dismisses the overlay. The app MUST NOT declare the INTERNET permission. Uninstall is protected by regular Device-Admin (consumer-grade, user-revocable). Stack: Kotlin + Coroutines/Flow, Jetpack Compose + Material3 (Activities), XML view for the WindowManager overlay, Room (mock seams first), minSdk 29 / targetSdk 35 / compileSdk 35.
